rows.actor: Convicted and sentenced individual petitions; state of Utah represented by Attorney General for felony challenges, otherwise the governmental prosecuting entity. Judge decides grounds and relief; no fabricated attorney representation or declaration.

Section105(1)(b) requires clear-and-convincing proof, not the general PCRA preponderance standard.
rows.timing: Section107(1)-(2): one year from the latest applicable statutory accrual event, not one year automatically from conviction. Section107(3)(a) permits tolling for the specified prevention, including force/fraud/coercion on(h) claims; petitioner proves tolling. Section106 preclusion and its3(b) exception remain relevant. No automatic timeliness calculation from a survivor label. Rule65C(h) permits21-day pleading correction and one additional21-day extension for good cause; respondent normally30days after service. Existing statute108(3)(a) says five-day stay while Rule65C(o) prints seven days: do not automate a release/stay date from this inconsistent pair; actual court order and legal review control that narrow postgrant issue.

rows.selfHelpStop: Do not generate an asserted trafficking nexus, sworn evidence, satisfied clear-and-convincing standard, exception to preclusion, or tolling fact.
